newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Jugos Del Valle launches ADRs.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Jugos Del Valle launches ADRs.

text.p: Jugos Del Valle, Mexico's leading fruit juice and juice drink maker, said Wednesday it has launched a Level 1 ADR program.
"Jugos ADRs will trade OTC under the symbol JUVAY. Each ADR equals five common shares. Jugos' depositary is Bankers Trust," the company said in a statement.
Jugos Del Valle has a 29 percent domestic market share in fruit juice and fruit juice drinks and an expanding presence in international markets.

"The Level 1 program will provide Jugos with a significantly expanded market for our securities, and an enhanced profile with potential buyers of our products in international markets," Eduardo Marino, the company's CFO said in the statement.
Marino said the Level 1 vehicle was an exciting step for the company in its efforts to diversify its shareholder base, increase liquidity and build share value.
Jugos is returning to its historical growth rate of 12 percent a year and recent management decisions have positioned the company to capitalise on Mexico's economic recovery, Marino added.
